explicit.reason: Sorrento Therapeutics — delisted (bankruptcy); its house price series is not usable (two price stores disagree by orders of magnitude). Operator 2026-10-26: "remove SRNE and any delisted". Its bad price rows are kept for the quarantine script (#2202), never deleted here.

never_exclude_note: Symbols listed here are never auto-excluded (an operator override when a detector is wrong). Cash sweeps are not in the prospectus universe and need no entry.
no_price_sessions_note: Weekday sessions between the symbol's last house daily close and the freshest house close among the names checked (never the wall clock, so a house-wide ingest outage excludes nothing). 10 covers a holiday week plus a late ingest; a symbol with NO bars at all is not excluded (a new add or an ingest gap is a data gap, not a delisting).

terminal_collapse.note: The last close at or below 2% of the median of the prior 20 closes (a 98% one-step collapse) is a terminal bar.
